summary: frontend-orb ships obfuscated preinstall loader that downloads Bun and executes a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: frontend-orb is published as a CircleCI orb (YAML CI helpers under src/), but its package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers such as _0x488df8, _0x52943e, string-object property-lookup tables in helpers mu/dl/xn/xb) and performs a drop-and-exec sequence: it builds a URL against github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/, fetches the Bun runtime binary to a temp path, chmods it 0755, and then execFileSync's the downloaded Bun against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line file with obfuscator.io fingerprints (rotating string-array decoder WV8StW that shifts a large numeric/string constant array n7gIxM, hex-mangled identifiers) and is not referenced by any of the orb YAML files. The advertised purpose of the package (a CircleCI orb) has no need for a JavaScript runtime, an obfuscated loader, or a 727KB opaque payload. On npm install, the obfuscated preinstall chain runs an opaque payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime, giving the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine while evading Node-based introspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
